QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR GEO
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
What is Generative Engine Optimisation?

GEO is the practice of optimising your brand and content to be cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Claude. As more people use AI for search, appearing in these answers is as important as ranking on Google.
Is GEO different from SEO?

Yes and no. GEO builds on SEO foundations — high-quality content, strong domain authority, proper schema markup — but goes further by focusing on how AI systems understand and cite your brand. The best approach combines both.
Can you measure GEO results?

Yes. We track how often your brand is cited in AI responses, what's said about you, and whether responses are accurate. We also monitor traffic from AI platforms via UTM tracking and referral analytics.
How long does GEO take?
Initial improvements can be seen within 3–6 months as AI systems re-crawl the web and update their training. Knowledge graph improvements and authoritative content tend to compound over 6–18 months.
Which AI engines do you optimise for?
ChatGPT (OpenAI), Perplexity AI, Google AI Overviews (SGE), Gemini, Claude (Anthropic), Bing Copilot, and You.com. The core principles apply across all of them.
